about: fabric-package/1 vectors (DEC-0050, DEC-0051): the digest, the signing input, the folder check and the verifier, for the kits' ports. The seeds are test keys derived as SHA-256 of a label; they sign nothing real and must never be used. Ed25519 is deterministic, so a port's signer reproduces every sig from its seed.
